name: red-initial
purpose: C014 RED: the initial specification tests (initial-a: canary sweep, allow-list shape, signature, management route; initial-b: refusal table and pipelining) against the NAIVE stub (field-name blocklist per route, raw records served, refusals on a kept-alive connection). Written before any production file exists; every failing test fails on a behavioral assertion (a canary found in an answer, a field outside the allow-list, no Connection: close, a mutation that ran behind a refusal).
